structure.unit: Food and Drink; Weights and Measures

law.catch_line: Falsification or presealing of weight certificate by licensed weighmaster; delegation of authority to unlicensed person
law.text: Any licensed public weighmaster who falsifies a weight certificate, or who delegates his authority to any person not licensed as a licensed public weighmaster, or who preseals a weight certificate with his official seal before performing the act of weighing, is guilty of a Class 2 misdemeanor.
